name: Python and data tooling
description: Python packages, typing, pytest suites and small data tooling. Use when the issue lives in a Python repository.
author: ContribMatch community

vocabulary.pull request: A change you propose to a Python project, with a description and a test.
vocabulary.type hint: A type written next to a function so readers and tools know what to expect.

python: Name the module and the function you would change.
Say which behaviour changes at the function boundary, not only inside the body.
pytest: Name the test file and the case you would add.
Say what the test asserts, in one sentence.
typing: Say which public functions get type hints and which types you would use.
Mention whether mypy or pyright runs in the project's CI.
packaging: Say which packaging file changes and why the metadata is needed.
Check the supported Python versions before you change anything.
